alt: Side by side: 3247 First Language Urdu, for candidates whose main language is Urdu, pairs Paper 1 Reading and Writing (50%) with Paper 2 Texts (50%); 3248 Second Language Urdu, for learners, pairs Paper 1 (50%) with Paper 2 Grammar, Writing and Translation (50%).
caption: Same Paper 1 title and weighting, different second papers and different candidates.

alt: 3247 Paper 1 lasts 1 hour 30 minutes in two parts, Reading 25 marks and Writing 25 marks. 3248 Paper 1 lasts 1 hour 45 minutes in five exercises worth 8, 9, 9, 10 and 14 marks, including a summary exercise.
caption: Same title, different duration, structure and tasks.

alt: A decision: if Urdu is the main language, 3247 First Language, which assumes fluency and includes literary texts; if Urdu was learned in addition, 3248 Second Language, which tests practical communication, grammar and translation. A fluent speaker on 3248 is capped; a learner on 3247 faces untaught literary demands.
caption: Confirm your route with your centre before revising.

alt: Four question types: what asks for located detail, why for inference, the writer's attitude for evidence from word choice and tone, and in your own words for rephrasing. 3248 sets an explicit summary exercise; 3247 has no separate summary task.
caption: Each question type needs a different kind of answer.

alt: Directed writing covers letters, speeches, reports, articles and dialogues; the 3247 composition offers a choice of argumentative, discursive, descriptive and narrative titles. Plan the argument or the ending first, and match the register to the task.
caption: Know the format, plan before writing, and keep the register right.

alt: Six accuracy features: gender agreement, verb forms and consistent respect levels (tu, tum, aap), postpositions including the ergative ne, izafat and compounds, script accuracy with dots and diacritics, and Urdu punctuation.
caption: A small, predictable set of features: check every one before you finish.

alt: For a letter to the head teacher asking permission for a trip: respectful address and closing, aap throughout and never tum, formal vocabulary, and a clear request with reasons. The common error is slipping into informal address partway through.
caption: Choose the register once and hold it to the last line.
